## Convert specific categories into tags

You have two ways to convert specific product categories into product tags.

page_title: How to Convert WooCommerce Product Categories into Tags
category: Convert Woocommerce Product Categories Into Tags
heading_path: 1- Do it in the spreadsheet
text:
### 1- Do it in the spreadsheet

Locate the **Taxonomy** column in the spreadsheet, and select **product_tag** to convert them into tags.

![convert-woocommerce-product-categories-into-tags](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/23135808/convert-woocommerce-product-categories-into-tags-02.png)

You can convert multiple categories into tags by selecting the **product_tag** value in the spreadsheet and then clicking on **Save** to apply the changes.

![convert woocommerce product categories into tags](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/23135850/convert-woocommerce-product-categories-into-tags-03.png)

page_title: How to Convert WooCommerce Product Categories into Tags
category: Convert Woocommerce Product Categories Into Tags
heading_path: 2- Select and convert categories in bulk
text:
### 2- Select and convert categories in bulk

The spreadsheet includes a checkbox picker where you can select every category that you want to convert into a tag. In the screenshot below, we have selected multiple categories, which we will convert into tags in bulk.

After selecting the categories you will convert, open the **Bulk Edit** tool.

![convert-woocommerce-product-categories-into-tags](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/23141334/convert-woocommerce-product-categories-into-tags-07-2048x1165-1.jpg)

Once you’re in the **Bulk Edit** tool, select these values to convert all the selected categories into tags:

- **Select the rows that you want to update:** Edit all the rows that I selected manually in the spreadsheet
- **What field do you want to edit:** Taxonomy
- **Select type of edit:** Set value
- **Replace existing value with this value:** product_tag
- **Tip:** Pay attention to the number of categories that will be converted to make sure the number matches your selection.
- Click on **Execute Now.**

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet
heading_path: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
text:
Need to edit WooCommerce stock in a spreadsheet or update stock quantities for multiple products? With **WP Sheet Editor – WooCommerce Products**, you can manage your inventory in a spreadsheet directly inside WordPress.

Instead of opening each product individually, you can:

- **Update stock quantities** for multiple products in one place.
- **Change stock status** to In stock, Out of stock, or On backorder.
- **Enable or disable stock management** for individual products.
- **Edit different products at the same time** and save your changes together.

You don’t need to export products to Excel or upload CSV files. You can edit your existing WooCommerce inventory directly in the spreadsheet.

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet
heading_path: 1. Install WP Sheet Editor for WooCommerce Products
text:
## 1. Install WP Sheet Editor for WooCommerce Products

First, install and activate **WP Sheet Editor – WooCommerce Products** on your WordPress website.

Get WP Sheet Editor - WooCommerce Products:

[Start editing WooCommerce stock in a spreadsheet](https://wpsheeteditor.com/buy-extension/?extension_id=778&utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=how-to-edit-woocommerce-stock-in-a-spreadsheet#buy) - or - [Check the features](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/woocommerce-spreadsheet/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=how-to-edit-woocommerce-stock-in-a-spreadsheet)
The plugin adds a spreadsheet editor to your WordPress dashboard. Each row represents a product, and each column contains a product field, including inventory settings.

This lets you see stock information for multiple products and edit it without switching between individual product pages.

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet
heading_path: 2. Open your WooCommerce products in the spreadsheet
text:
## 2. Open your WooCommerce products in the spreadsheet

Go to **WP Sheet Editor > Edit Products**.

You’ll see your WooCommerce product catalog in a spreadsheet.

![how-to-edit-woocommerce-stock-in-a-spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/21005829/edit-stock-in-a-spreadsheet-woocommerce.png)

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet
heading_path: 3. Edit WooCommerce stock in a spreadsheet
text:
## 3. Edit WooCommerce stock in a spreadsheet

You can now change your inventory information directly in the spreadsheet cells.

Find these three columns:

- **Manage stock:** Enable or disable quantity-based inventory tracking.
- **Stock:** Enter the available stock quantity for each product.
- **Stock status:** Select **In stock**, **Out of stock**, or **On backorder**, as applicable.

![how-to-edit-woocommerce-stock-in-a-spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/21010102/woocommerce-stock-columns.png)

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet
heading_path: Update stock quantities for multiple products
text:
### Update stock quantities for multiple products

Find the **Stock** column and enter the new quantity for each product.

For example, you can change one product from 5 to 20 units, another from 12 to 8, and another from 30 to 15.

You can edit as many product rows as needed without leaving the spreadsheet.

If you want WooCommerce to track quantities automatically, make sure the **Manage stock** option is enabled for the relevant products.

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet
heading_path: Change WooCommerce stock status
text:
### Change WooCommerce stock status

You can also edit the **Stock status** column to change the availability of products that aren’t using quantity-based stock management.

When WooCommerce manages stock quantities automatically, stock status is normally determined by the available quantity and backorder settings.

page_title: How to Edit WooCommerce Stock in a Spreadsheet
category: How To Edit Woocommerce Stock In A Spreadsheet

text:

After updating your products, click **Save**.

![edit woocommerce stock in a spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/21010400/save-stock-edited-in-spreadsheet.png)

WP Sheet Editor saves your changes to your WooCommerce products. You don’t have to open each product and save it separately.

page_title: Easy LearnDash Google Sheets Integration
heading_path: What can you manage?
text:
## What can you manage?

- **Courses:** Titles, content, access settings, pricing, categories, tags, certificates, and other course fields.
- **Lessons:** Content, video URLs, course assignments, ordering, materials, timers, and drip schedules.
- **Topics:** Topic content and course or lesson relationships.

- **Questions:** Question text, types, points, answers, hints, and quiz relationships.

page_title: The Events Calendar Export Events to CSV, Excel or Google Sheets
heading_path: The Events Calendar Export Events to CSV, Excel or Google Sheets
text:
In this tutorial, you will learn how to export events from The Events Calendar to a CSV file, Excel or Google Sheets. We will use the **WP Sheet Editor – The Events Calendar** plugin, which allows you to view and manage your Events in a spreadsheet on the WordPress dashboard. It includes advanced search, bulk edit, export and import tools.

You can download the plugin here:

[Download Events Spreadsheet Plugin](https://wpsheeteditor.com/buy-extension/?extension_id=1002&utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=the-events-calendar-export-events#buy) - or - [Check the features](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/events-spreadsheet/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=the-events-calendar-export-events)
Once you install the plugin, go to **WP Sheet Editor > Edit Events** to view all The Events Calendar events in a spreadsheet.

![The Events Calendar events displayed in the WP Sheet Editor spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/22182939/the-events-calendar-export-events-01.png)

Now let’s see how to export events to different formats and platforms:

page_title: The Events Calendar Export Events to CSV, Excel or Google Sheets
heading_path: Option 1: Export The Events Calendar to CSV file
text:
## Option 1: Export The Events Calendar to CSV file

Open the **Export** tool on the top toolbar.

![Open the Export tool in the events spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/22183004/the-events-calendar-export-events-02.png)

Now configure these values to download the data of your events in a CSV file:

- **Which columns do you want to export:** You can export all columns or only selected columns.
- **Which rows do you want to export:** You can export all your events, only the events from a specific search, or the events that you have manually selected in the spreadsheet.
- **What app will you use to edit this file:** Here you need to select the format. In this example, we will select **CSV File.**
- **Name of this export:** You can enter a name here and run this same export in the future with one click.
- Click on **Start new export.**

## Option 2: Export your events to Excel file (XLSX)

To export The Events Calendar to a Microsoft Excel file (XLSX), first open the **Export** tool.

![Open the Export tool in the events spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/22183004/the-events-calendar-export-events-02.png)

After you open the **Export** tool, select these values to download the events data in an Excel file:

- **Which columns do you want to export:** You can export all columns or only selected columns.
- **Which rows do you want to export:** You can export all your events, only the events from a specific search, or the events that you have manually selected in the spreadsheet.
- **What app will you use to edit this file:** Microsoft Excel (XLSX)
- **Name of this export:** You can enter a name here and run this same export in the future with one click.
- Click on **Start new export.**

Yes, you can manage and export / import events, organizers and venues.

page_title: The Events Calendar Export Events to CSV, Excel or Google Sheets
heading_path: Can I export only selected events?
text:
### Can I export only selected events?

Yes, you can do this in two ways:

1. Use the **Search** tool to filter events by status, price, organizer, venue, or any other field. Once done, export all the results from your search.
2. Use the checkbox picker to mark specific events and export only the events that you manually selected.
